answer_1.quote: When answering how-to questions, the system integrated with THREAD enables a dynamic interaction manner. First, it retrieves relevant LUs based on their indexed headers. Then, the body of the selected LU provides the necessary content to generate responses for the current step.
answer_1.outputs: Generated step‑by‑step answers / action plans for how‑to questions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of THREAD through experiments... metrics include Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc), Operation F1 (Op. F1), Step Success Rate (Step SR), Success Rate (SR), Precision, Recall and F1.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation with twenty on‑call engineers (OCEs) responsible for incident mitigation. Each OCE mitigates five incidents, with baseline methods randomly assigned per incident... We collect metrics such as Success Rate (SR), Step Success Rate (Step SR), Pre‑Failure Step SR, Human Intervention (HI) and Average Turns.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators assess incident mitigation outcomes using criteria like SR, Step SR, P.F. Step SR, HI and Turns.
